task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Pick the medium sauce can with white lid up and carefully position it beside the kitchenpot with smooth metallic lid
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高稳定性，不变形，进入框架，拿起带有白色盖子的中号酱罐，小心地将其放置在带有光滑金属盖子的厨房锅旁边
